title: Handle with Care: Setting Boundaries Around Sensitive Subjects
coreMove: When a subject touches grief, health, trauma, identity, body, or family planning, center impact over intention and protect privacy before explaining yourself.

exampleSpecs.domain: grief questions from a parent's circle
exampleSpecs.audience: readers depleted by repeated explanations after loss
exampleSpecs.stakes: father's friends keep asking for details that turn grief into another performance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the limit protecting grief energy without accusing every caller of bad intent.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers facing stranger curiosity in public
exampleSpecs.stakes: a public line turns into an uninvited hair touch
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a public boundary with no need to preserve an ongoing relationship.

exampleSpecs.domain: airplane trauma question to a military veteran
exampleSpecs.audience: readers asked to disclose painful history to strangers
exampleSpecs.stakes: a thank-you for service pivots into a killing question
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show gratitude failing to authorize trauma access.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers fielding pregnancy or baby questions
exampleSpecs.stakes: casual baby talk can touch grief, infertility, medical history, or private choice
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show that innocent phrasing does not guarantee a gentle impact.

exampleSpecs.domain: health and recovery privacy after a clinic visit
exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose concern-filled relatives ask for medical details
exampleSpecs.stakes: mental and physical health privacy gets framed as family concern
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show concern not overriding privacy around recovery or illness.

exampleSpecs.domain: meeting repair after an identity comment
exampleSpecs.audience: readers deciding whether to educate, redirect, or ask for public repair
exampleSpecs.stakes: good intentions threaten to bury the public impact of a sensitive comment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show impact over intention without making education mandatory.
